en: With je, aller becomes vais: je vais au parc.
With tu, aller becomes vas: tu vas.
With il or elle, aller becomes va: il va.
With nous, aller becomes allons: nous allons.
With vous, aller becomes allez: vous allez.
With ils or elles, aller becomes vont: elles vont.
With je, faire becomes fais: je fais mes devoirs.
With tu, faire becomes fais: tu fais du vélo.
Mon père is one person (il), so faire becomes fait.
With nous, faire becomes faisons: nous faisons du ski.
With vous, faire becomes faites: vous faites.
With ils or elles, faire becomes font: ils font un gâteau.
Which form of aller goes with nous?
Nous allons means we go or we are going.
Which form of faire goes with vous?
Vous faites is irregular. Faisez is not a real French word.
Je vais comes from aller (to go), so it means I go or I am going.
In Il fait ses devoirs, what does il fait mean?
Il fait comes from faire (to do), so it means he does.
French uses faire for the weather: il fait beau means the weather is nice.
For weather, use il fait: il fait froid means it is cold.
Comment vas-tu ? means How are you? It uses tu vas from aller.
What does Je vais bien mean?
Aller bien means to be well, so je vais bien means I am fine.
Ma sœur et moi ___ au zoo.
Ma sœur et moi means we, so we need nous allons.
Paul et Léa ___ de la natation.
Paul et Léa means they (ils), so faire becomes font.
With ils, aller becomes vont. Allent is not a real word.
How do you say We are going to school in French?
Going somewhere uses aller, and with nous it is allons.
How do you say She does the shopping in French?
Faire les courses means to do the shopping. With elle, use fait.
How do you say You (plural) are going to the beach in French?
Going uses aller, and with vous it is allez.
Which French verb means to go?
Aller means to go. Faire means to do and avoir means to have.
On uses the same form as il, and faire une promenade means to go for a walk.
Tu ___ au lit à neuf heures.
Aller au lit means to go to bed. With tu, use vas.

example.why_en: With je, aller becomes vais: je vais au parc.

en.title: Aller and faire
en.teach: Aller (to go) and faire (to do, to make) are irregular, so learn them by heart: je vais, nous allons; je fais, nous faisons. Example: Nous allons au parc.
